events.title: Google releases Gemini 3.7 Flash — agentic/coding workhorse tier at 50% intro price
events.summary: Google shipped Gemini 3.7 Flash three weeks after 3.6 Flash, positioned as its most intelligent workhorse model for coding and agents. Day-one GA in Gemini API/AI Studio and same-day availability in GitHub Copilot. Intro pricing $0.75/M input and $3.75/M output through 2026-12-31, then $1.50/$7.50.
events.why_it_matters: Sub-$1/M input for near-frontier agentic scores changes model-selection defaults for high-volume agent loops; the 3-week Flash cadence is itself a competitive-velocity signal.
events.summary_zh: Google 在 3.6 Flash 发布三周后推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，定位为面向 coding 和 agent 的最强 workhorse 模型。Gemini API/AI Studio 首日 GA，同日上线 GitHub Copilot。导入价 input $0.75/M、output $3.75/M，有效期至 2026-12-31，之后恢复 $1.50/$7.50。
events.summary_en: Google shipped Gemini 3.7 Flash three weeks after 3.6 Flash, positioned as its most intelligent workhorse model for coding and agents. Day-one GA in Gemini API/AI Studio and same-day availability in GitHub Copilot. Intro pricing $0.75/M input and $3.75/M output through 2026-12-31, then $1.50/$7.50.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 接近 frontier 水平的 agentic 得分配上低于 $1/M 的 input 价格，会改变高频 agent 循环的模型选型默认值；三周的 Flash 迭代节奏本身也是竞争速度信号。
events.why_it_matters_en: Sub-$1/M input for near-frontier agentic scores changes model-selection defaults for high-volume agent loops; the 3-week Flash cadence is itself a competitive-velocity signal.

events.title: DeepSeek V4-Pro GA — native OpenAI Responses API support, agent benchmarks, off-peak pricing
events.summary: DeepSeek moved V4-Pro from preview to GA across app/web/API (deepseek-v4-pro) with native OpenAI Responses API support and a one-click Codex configuration. Thinking-effort levels (low/high/max) added for V4-Pro and V4-Flash. Peak/off-peak pricing takes effect 2026-08-16T16:00Z with off-peak at 50% of peak.
events.why_it_matters: Responses-API compatibility makes DeepSeek a near-drop-in inside OpenAI-native agent stacks. Confirmed peak/off-peak rates (effective 2026-08-16T16:00Z) are a large increase vs current flat rates — V4-Pro output rises from $0.87 to $3.96/Mtok peak / $1.98 off-peak — so budget-sensitive agent workloads now need time-of-day scheduling or re-evaluation.
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek 将 V4-Pro 从 preview 转为 GA，覆盖 app/web/API（deepseek-v4-pro），原生支持 OpenAI Responses API，并提供一键 Codex 配置。V4-Pro 和 V4-Flash 新增 thinking-effort 档位（low/high/max）。峰谷定价于 2026-08-16T16:00Z 生效，谷价为峰价的 50%。
events.summary_en: DeepSeek moved V4-Pro from preview to GA across app/web/API (deepseek-v4-pro) with native OpenAI Responses API support and a one-click Codex configuration. Thinking-effort levels (low/high/max) added for V4-Pro and V4-Flash. Peak/off-peak pricing takes effect 2026-08-16T16:00Z with off-peak at 50% of peak.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 兼容 Responses API 使 DeepSeek 在 OpenAI 原生 agent 技术栈中接近即插即用。已确认的峰谷定价（2026-08-16T16:00Z 生效）相对现行单一价格是大幅涨价——V4-Pro output 从 $0.87 涨至峰时 $3.96/Mtok、谷时 $1.98——预算敏感的 agent 负载现在需要按时段调度或重新评估。
events.why_it_matters_en: Responses-API compatibility makes DeepSeek a near-drop-in inside OpenAI-native agent stacks. Confirmed peak/off-peak rates (effective 2026-08-16T16:00Z) are a large increase vs current flat rates — V4-Pro output rises from $0.87 to $3.96/Mtok peak / $1.98 off-peak — so budget-sensitive agent workloads now need time-of-day scheduling or re-evaluation.
events.update_2026_08_16: Exact peak/off-peak rates confirmed from official pricing docs during 2026-08-16T00:00Z run. Net effect is a substantial price increase, not a discount: even off-peak V4-Pro output is ~2.3x the current flat rate, and peak is ~4.6x. Peak windows align with China business hours (09:00-12:00 / 14:00-18:00 Beijing). Concurrency limits unchanged: flash 2500, pro 500.

events.title: OpenAI previews Ultrafast mode — GPT-5.6 Sol served on Cerebras at up to 750 tok/s (~14x)
events.published_at_note: Timing discrepancy: TechCrunch article published 2026-08-13T19:22Z; openai.com/index/previewing-ultrafast/ page metadata shows publishedTime 2026-08-11T10:00Z. Staged announcement likely; treated as Aug 11-13 boundary event.
events.summary: OpenAI announced a preview of Ultrafast mode, serving GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 750 output tokens/sec (~14x standard) with inference powered by Cerebras wafer-scale hardware rather than GPUs. Access limited to a small preview group; pricing undisclosed.
events.why_it_matters: First time OpenAI serves its frontier model on third-party non-GPU inference silicon — validates alternative inference silicon at frontier quality and signals speed-tiered API products as the next competitive axis.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 Ultrafast mode 预览：GPT-5.6 Sol 输出速度最高 750 tokens/s（约为标准模式的 14 倍），推理由 Cerebras wafer-scale 硬件而非 GPU 提供。目前仅限小规模预览用户，价格未公布。
events.summary_en: OpenAI announced a preview of Ultrafast mode, serving GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 750 output tokens/sec (~14x standard) with inference powered by Cerebras wafer-scale hardware rather than GPUs. Access limited to a small preview group; pricing undisclosed.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 这是 OpenAI 首次将 frontier 模型跑在第三方非 GPU 推理芯片上——验证了替代推理芯片在 frontier 质量下的可行性，也预示按速度分层的 API 产品将成为下一个竞争轴。
events.why_it_matters_en: First time OpenAI serves its frontier model on third-party non-GPU inference silicon — validates alternative inference silicon at frontier quality and signals speed-tiered API products as the next competitive axis.

events.title: GitHub Copilot weekly release — Agent Plugins 1.0 GA, Kimi K3 rollout, Ollama BYOK in JetBrains
events.summary: Agent Plugins 1.0 went GA (build once, run across VS Code, Copilot CLI, Copilot SDK, Copilot app). Kimi K3 and MAI-Code-1.1-Flash rolled out across paid plans. Copilot CLI gained /tasks subagent view, --plan + --mode autopilot headless combos, /rewind. JetBrains added cross-session memory and Ollama as BYOK provider.
events.why_it_matters: Portable plugins are Copilot's play for an agent-ecosystem standard competing with MCP; Ollama BYOK in JetBrains signals local-model normalization inside enterprise IDEs.
events.summary_zh: Agent Plugins 1.0 GA（一次构建，跨 VS Code、Copilot CLI、Copilot SDK、Copilot app 运行）。Kimi K3 和 MAI-Code-1.1-Flash 向付费套餐推出。Copilot CLI 新增 /tasks subagent 视图、--plan + --mode autopilot 无头组合、/rewind。JetBrains 新增跨会话记忆，并支持 Ollama 作为 BYOK provider。
events.summary_en: Agent Plugins 1.0 went GA (build once, run across VS Code, Copilot CLI, Copilot SDK, Copilot app). Kimi K3 and MAI-Code-1.1-Flash rolled out across paid plans. Copilot CLI gained /tasks subagent view, --plan + --mode autopilot headless combos, /rewind. JetBrains added cross-session memory and Ollama as BYOK provider.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 可移植插件是 Copilot 打造与 MCP 竞争的 agent 生态标准的抓手；JetBrains 支持 Ollama BYOK 则标志本地模型在企业 IDE 中正走向常态化。
events.why_it_matters_en: Portable plugins are Copilot's play for an agent-ecosystem standard competing with MCP; Ollama BYOK in JetBrains signals local-model normalization inside enterprise IDEs.

events.title: Cursor launches Builds — pre-warmed cloud agent environments, up to 3x faster agent startup, default-on Aug 17
events.summary: Cursor shipped Builds: hourly background-prepared environments so cloud agents boot up to 3x faster; broken builds never go active (fallback to last good); dashboard Builds tab with logs/SHAs. Becomes default for all environments on Aug 17 at no extra cost.
events.why_it_matters: Warm-environment startup removes the biggest latency tax on cloud coding agents; default-on for everyone Aug 17 makes it the baseline to benchmark against.
events.summary_zh: Cursor 发布 Builds：每小时在后台预构建环境，使 cloud agent 启动速度最高提升 3 倍；构建失败的环境不会上线（回退到最近可用版本）；dashboard 新增带日志和 SHA 的 Builds 标签页。8 月 17 日起对所有环境默认开启，不额外收费。
events.summary_en: Cursor shipped Builds: hourly background-prepared environments so cloud agents boot up to 3x faster; broken builds never go active (fallback to last good); dashboard Builds tab with logs/SHAs. Becomes default for all environments on Aug 17 at no extra cost.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 预热环境消除了 cloud coding agent 最大的启动延迟开销；8 月 17 日全员默认开启后，它将成为同类产品对标延迟表现的基线。
events.why_it_matters_en: Warm-environment startup removes the biggest latency tax on cloud coding agents; default-on for everyone Aug 17 makes it the baseline to benchmark against.

events.title: Contract-grade verifier for LLM-generated GPU kernels finds ~40% of accepted kernels broken
events.summary: Paper presents a verifier with twelve adversarial property-based gates (many tolerance-free) for AI-generated GPU kernels; 98.5% agreement with reference correctness code. Used to audit 2,638 publicly accepted machine-generated kernels: 39.5% broken beyond any tolerance argument, 62.1% had at least one violation; field-standard tests accepted 1,487 kernels the verifier rejected.
events.why_it_matters: Directly actionable warning for anyone shipping LLM-generated code validated only by loose tests — property-based adversarial gates should become part of kernel/code CI.
events.summary_zh: 论文提出一个面向 AI 生成 GPU kernel 的验证器，包含 12 个对抗性 property-based 检查门（多数为零容差），与参考正确性代码的一致率达 98.5%。作者用它审计了 2,638 个已公开接收的机器生成 kernel：39.5% 存在任何容差都无法辩解的错误，62.1% 至少有一项违规；业界标准测试接收了其中 1,487 个被该验证器拒绝的 kernel。
events.summary_en: Paper presents a verifier with twelve adversarial property-based gates (many tolerance-free) for AI-generated GPU kernels; 98.5% agreement with reference correctness code. Used to audit 2,638 publicly accepted machine-generated kernels: 39.5% broken beyond any tolerance argument, 62.1% had at least one violation; field-standard tests accepted 1,487 kernels the verifier rejected.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对任何只靠宽松测试验证 LLM 生成代码就上线的团队，这是可直接行动的警告——property-based 对抗性检查应成为 kernel/代码 CI 的一部分。
events.why_it_matters_en: Directly actionable warning for anyone shipping LLM-generated code validated only by loose tests — property-based adversarial gates should become part of kernel/code CI.

events.title: DARTree: speculative diffusion decoding with autoregressive draft trees — up to 9.73x lossless speedup
events.summary: Training-free extension of a pretrained autoregressive correction head from single chains to trees for diffusion speculative decoding; fixed-width candidate trees scored per-depth in one batch with best-first pruning. Up to 12.97 tokens accepted per verification round (+98.6% vs DFlash, +27.9% vs Domino) and up to 9.73x lossless speedup across 7 benchmarks.
events.why_it_matters: If reproducible, this is a material inference-serving acceleration technique; relevant to vLLM/SGLang-class stacks. No code repo yet.
events.summary_zh: 论文将预训练 autoregressive 修正头从单链免训练扩展到树结构，用于 diffusion speculative decoding；定宽候选树按深度在单批次内打分，配合 best-first 剪枝。单轮验证最多接收 12.97 个 token（较 DFlash +98.6%，较 Domino +27.9%），在 7 个 benchmark 上最高实现 9.73 倍无损加速。
events.summary_en: Training-free extension of a pretrained autoregressive correction head from single chains to trees for diffusion speculative decoding; fixed-width candidate trees scored per-depth in one batch with best-first pruning. Up to 12.97 tokens accepted per verification round (+98.6% vs DFlash, +27.9% vs Domino) and up to 9.73x lossless speedup across 7 benchmarks.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 如果结果可复现，这是一项有实质价值的推理服务加速技术，与 vLLM/SGLang 级别的推理栈直接相关。目前尚无代码仓库。
events.why_it_matters_en: If reproducible, this is a material inference-serving acceleration technique; relevant to vLLM/SGLang-class stacks. No code repo yet.

events.title: DCD: decoupled contrastive decoding — 1.65-1.95x speedup with expert-aligned drafting, code released
events.summary: Decoupled Contrastive Decoding achieves 1.65-1.95x speedup over vanilla contrastive decoding using EAGLE3-style expert-aligned drafting, with code available on GitHub.
events.why_it_matters: Practical decoding-acceleration method with released code — lower verification cost than most decoding papers.
events.summary_zh: Decoupled Contrastive Decoding 采用 EAGLE3 风格的 expert-aligned drafting，相对原版 contrastive decoding 实现 1.65–1.95 倍加速，代码已在 GitHub 发布。
events.summary_en: Decoupled Contrastive Decoding achieves 1.65-1.95x speedup over vanilla contrastive decoding using EAGLE3-style expert-aligned drafting, with code available on GitHub.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 带开源代码的实用解码加速方法——验证成本低于大多数解码方向的论文。
events.why_it_matters_en: Practical decoding-acceleration method with released code — lower verification cost than most decoding papers.
